7827.title: Directory clipboard items enter the attachment pipeline
7827.rootCauseOneLine: The composer forwards every non-null file-kind clipboard item to attachment handling without directory discrimination; native Finder payload and failure remain unverified.
7827.proposedFix: Inspect the actual macOS clipboard payload, distinguish directories, and design a narrowly scoped desktop path resolver while preserving normal file/image attachments.
7827.caveats: Linux-only synthetic clipboard boundary reproduction repeated in a second clean checkout; no native Finder, directory read failure, full-path insertion, or toast reproduced. No safe simple fix.
